name: The Hourglass Beach
description: A giant hourglass on a beach holds ocean waves in one chamber and golden sand dunes in the other.
prompt: Giant hourglass half-buried on a tropical beach, top chamber filled with rolling ocean waves, bottom chamber filled with golden sand dunes, tiny beach umbrellas and footprints around the base, sea foam, sunset, surreal photorealistic, no text, no logos.
caption: Time moves differently when the ocean is inside an hourglass. ⏳🌊
